title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Pliny dittany: internal foreign body exits after the wounded animal eats
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Pliny reports a wounded hind eating dittany and the weapon falling out.
